raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #64761 by preserving the installed source-built Triton version in the image's existing uv overrides file. The reported constrained downstream `uv pip install` can then add dependencies while retaining the customized Torch/Triton runtime.

## Claims

- Records the exact installed Triton version after a successful source-wheel installation, alongside the existing NCCL override.
- Resolves the reported constrained downstream installation without changing captured runtime versions or metadata.
- Documents the supported downstream uv installation procedure.

## Validation

Tested on Linux aarch64 using the issue's exact image:
`vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:d8f44d07d74900d0043eebc7e0c2b2d952caf92fb66d4400ef2dd902c5d3dcf0`, Python 3.12.3, uv 0.13.6.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Original image, `b12x==1.5.1` dry run with exact Torch/Triton constraints | Failed with the reported Triton 3.9.0 versus 3.8.0 conflict |
| Apply the new override command, repeat the same dry run | Passed |
| Install full reported auxiliary package set with captured runtime constraints | Passed |
| Compare runtime versions and SHA-256 hashes of `METADATA` before/after | Identical |
| Pre-commit on all three changed files; `git diff --check` | Passed |

The full installation command was:

```bash
uv pip install --system --break-system-packages --prerelease=allow \
  --constraint /tmp/runtime-constraints.txt \
  'ray[cgraph]>=2.48.0' runai-model-streamer b12x==1.5.1 \
  fastsafetensors==0.5.0 pytest
```

Constraints captured installed `torch`, `torchvision`, `torchaudio`, `triton`, `cuda-bindings`, `cuda-python`, and all `nvidia-*` distributions. Torch remained `2.16.0.dev20261009+cu134`; Triton remained `3.8.0+git3f6e4113`. The test applied the exact new override command to the published image; it was not a full from-source Docker rebuild. No GPU inference or model evaluation was run: this change concerns dependency resolution and does not change the selected runtime versions.

<details>
<summary>Complete reproduction (ARM64 Docker host, no GPU required)</summary>

```bash
docker run --rm -i --platform linux/arm64 --entrypoint bash \
  vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:d8f44d07d74900d0043eebc7e0c2b2d952caf92fb66d4400ef2dd902c5d3dcf0 <<'CONTAINER'
cat > /tmp/capture_runtime.py <<'PYTHON'
import hashlib
import json
from importlib.metadata import distribution, distributions
from pathlib import Path

names = {"torch", "torchvision", "torchaudio", "triton", "cuda-bindings", "cuda-python"}
names.update(
    dist.metadata["Name"]
    for dist in distributions()
    if dist.metadata["Name"].lower().startswith("nvidia-")
)
runtime = {}
for name in sorted(names):
    dist = distribution(name)
    metadata = dist.read_text("METADATA")
    runtime[name] = {
        "version": dist.version,
        "metadata_sha256": hashlib.sha256(metadata.encode()).hexdigest(),
    }
print(json.dumps(runtime, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
Path("/tmp/runtime-constraints.txt").write_text(
    "".join(f"{name}=={data['version']}\n" for name, data in runtime.items())
)
Path("/tmp/torch-triton-constraints.txt").write_text(
    "".join(f"{name}=={runtime[name]['version']}\n" for name in ("torch", "triton"))
)
PYTHON
set -euo pipefail
uv --version
uv venv --system-site-packages /tmp/repro/.venv
/tmp/repro/.venv/bin/python /tmp/capture_runtime.py > /tmp/runtime-before.json
cat /tmp/runtime-before.json
printf '\nExisting uv overrides:\n'
cat /etc/uv-overrides.txt
set +e
uv pip install --system --break-system-packages --prerelease=allow \
    --dry-run --constraint /tmp/torch-triton-constraints.txt b12x==1.5.1 \
    > /tmp/baseline.log 2>&1
baseline_status=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/baseline.log
printf '\nBASELINE_EXIT=%s\n' "$baseline_status"
test "$baseline_status" -ne 0
grep -q 'triton' /tmp/baseline.log
grep -q '3.8.0+git3f6e4113' /tmp/baseline.log
grep -q '3.9.0+gitfc8d31a5' /tmp/baseline.log
uv pip list --system --format freeze \
    | grep '^triton==' >> /etc/uv-overrides.txt
printf '\nUpdated uv overrides:\n'
cat /etc/uv-overrides.txt
uv pip install --system --break-system-packages --prerelease=allow \
    --dry-run --constraint /tmp/torch-triton-constraints.txt b12x==1.5.1
uv pip install --system --break-system-packages --prerelease=allow \
    --constraint /tmp/runtime-constraints.txt \
    'ray[cgraph]>=2.48.0' runai-model-streamer b12x==1.5.1 \
    fastsafetensors==0.5.0 pytest
/tmp/repro/.venv/bin/python /tmp/capture_runtime.py > /tmp/runtime-after.json
diff -u /tmp/runtime-before.json /tmp/runtime-after.json
uv pip show --system b12x fastsafetensors runai-model-streamer ray pytest
printf '\nPASS: install succeeds; runtime versions and METADATA hashes unchanged.\n'
CONTAINER
```

</details>

## Details

The source Triton installer intentionally uses `--no-deps`, while PyTorch's wheel metadata still requires another Triton version. Constraints cannot replace that transitive requirement. Reusing `UV_OVERRIDE=/etc/uv-overrides.txt` supplies the intentional override for later uv installs without rewriting metadata.

The append is chained to successful installation so installer/checksum/PTXAS failures still fail the Docker layer. `uv pip list --format freeze` supplies a version pin instead of an ephemeral local wheel URL. Builds without source-built Triton keep their current behavior. This does not make wheel metadata dependency-consistent; pip does not read `UV_OVERRIDE`.

Duplicate-work checks: the issue is unassigned with no comments; open PR searches for `64761 in:body` and the affected cu134/Triton area found no matching fix. The Kimi-K3 kernel-selection PR #60470 is unrelated.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, documentation, and validation.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

files.patch:
@@ -1277,7 +1277,7 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
     fi
 
 # Install source-built Triton last so dependency resolution cannot restore the
-# previously installed version.
+# previously installed version. Preserve it in downstream uv installs too.
 COPY --from=extensions-build \
     /tmp/triton_from_source_workspace/dist/wheel.sha256 \
     /tmp/triton-source-wheel.sha256
@@ -1304,7 +1304,9 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
             bash /tmp/install_triton_from_source.sh \
                 /tmp/triton-source-dist \
                 /tmp/triton-source-wheel.sha256; \
-        fi; \
+        fi \
+        && uv pip list --system --format freeze \
+            | grep '^triton==' >> /etc/uv-overrides.txt; \
     fi \
     && rm -f \
         /tmp/install_triton_from_source.sh \

@@ -28,6 +28,10 @@ certificate removals when the image is rebuilt. This complements the Python
 The `extensions-build` stage can also produce an optional source-built Triton
 wheel. `vllm-openai-base` installs that wheel after its other Python
 dependencies so dependency resolution cannot restore an older Triton version.
+It also records the installed Triton version in `/etc/uv-overrides.txt`, which
+the image's `UV_OVERRIDE` environment variable applies to downstream `uv pip`
+installs. This preserves the source-built version even when PyTorch requires
+a different Triton version.
 
 With `BUILD_NIXL=true`, `extensions-build` also builds NIXL, including its NIXL
 EP extension for the installed PyTorch, with `tools/build_nixl_with_torch215_for_rubin.py`.

@@ -454,6 +454,13 @@ lowers SM107 through LLVM's SM100 target and uses the final CUDA image's
 version-matched `ptxas` for SM107 assembly. This enables vLLM's default compiled
 mode on VR200 and R100.
 
+When extending this image, install additional Python packages with
+`uv pip install --system`. The image sets `UV_OVERRIDE=/etc/uv-overrides.txt`
+to preserve its custom Triton and NCCL versions when resolving dependencies.
+Include this file alongside any additional files supplied through `UV_OVERRIDE`
+or `--overrides`. A constraints file alone cannot override PyTorch's dependency
+on a different Triton version; `pip` does not read `UV_OVERRIDE`.
+
 BuildKit does not automatically invalidate cached layers when a mutable Git
 ref changes. Use `--no-cache-filter extensions-build` to refresh an empty,
 branch, or tag revision.
